items.title: RISC-V & Tomasulo Simulator
items.tagline: Explore processor execution cycle by cycle.
items.description: A browser-based teaching simulator for classic five-stage pipelines, Tomasulo scheduling, and speculative execution. Write or load RISC-V assembly, step through state changes, and inspect stalls, hazards, and performance metrics.

items.title: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe
items.tagline: A minimax arena for a strategic classic.
items.description: A browser-native Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe experience with human-versus-AI, local, and AI-versus-AI play; depth-limited minimax with alpha-beta pruning; saved replays; and guided lessons.

items.title: CESSA Vault
items.tagline: University course material, made easier to explore.
items.description: A searchable, department-based library for browsing and downloading university course resources, including lecture material, assignments, exams, and project archives.
